name: Light's Justice
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
narrative.objectives: Collect 25 Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice!With these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.
narrative.requestItemsText: What remains of the invading scourge? Have you managed to find suitable replacement parts?
